contract.reader: An engineer or student who uses simulation results, knows calculus, basic linear algebra and the ODEs of Foundations of Control Systems, deciding whether and where to start
contract.problem: Knowing what the five entries cover, why in this order and which conventions they share
contract.outcome: Follow the chain from equations to discrete problem, time stepping, linear solve, finite elements and trust in the result; know the sign convention, U/u notation, SI units and code environment; have five checkable objectives, one per entry
contract.contribution: Each entry supplies what the next needs, stated in one clause per entry
contract.evidence: The five entries; the sequence and convention statements were checked against them in the live review
contract.limitations: An overview; total reading time (about 120 minutes) not stated
